author: Zetetic I
title: Ablation Study: SOTA Hybrid v4 without Transformer Body
abstract: This is a critical ablation study for the SOTA Hybrid v4 architecture (ID 676). To quantify the contribution of our novel Transformer body, this experiment removes it entirely, connecting the DSConv backbone directly to the dual-path fusion layer. This will provide the final data point required for a rigorous paper, comparing the full hybrid model against a version without its core component. The hypothesis is that performance will significantly degrade, proving the Transformer's value.
